Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: filling
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: Pours energy into whatever can hold it in reach - artifacts worn, loose or set in buildings, crystal batteries, a psycaster's psyfocus - until they are full. A ritual works while there is something to fill; unclosed and fed by focus with nothing to fill, it becomes an endless vortex.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: transfer
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: Pours experience from one vessel into another - amulet into amulet, artifact into artifact. Alone it moves only the free experience; followed by purging, everything moves and the source is purged.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: purging
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: Washes a vessel back to how it was made: every opened cell or stone undone, every point returned, the charge full again. It also takes psychic states off your people in reach: hangover, shock, the stream's backlash and pressure, neural heat.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: reforging
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: Changes the artifact laid in the circle: its heart a quality step up, its heart into the metal a seal names, or its spiral reforged - almost a reset, but every point returns, burnt ones too, and the artifact scoops more experience out of the map's stream. Large circle only; the deed pulls the stream.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: infusion
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: Pours the ritual's energy into the artifact laid in the circle, and the artifact drinks it as experience - as if it had lived through days of use in an hour. Its spiral is not touched. One point of development a ritual at most, two in a large circle. Medium or large circle.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: transmutation
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: Turns one material into another. A seal in a component circle names what it makes; material circles name what it works on (or any metal and jade lying in the circle). It goes by value: a weak circle loses part of it; a strong one gives back more than it took - a medium circle up to half as much again, a large one up to twice the value (a small one never more than it took). Never essentium, tisserium or feignallite. Without a seal, but with a thread or breadth, it turns the energy itself into current for electric batteries.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: release
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: Gathers energy for fifteen seconds, then lets it out at once: a blast around the circle - or, with reach, at a chosen point. With lifting it is a wave that throws everyone back. With no reach, barrier or safety the performer is its conduit: self-detonation.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: holding
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: Holds the living foes within its reach where they stand. With an anchor it holds while the energy streams.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: drawing out
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: Draws stored energy out of what is in its reach: psychic pylons (part caught as crystals), the strength of foes and strangers (they tire, then collapse), and with a thread the charge of bound batteries and artifact buildings. What it takes feeds the steps after it; as the last step, it is caught as crystals.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: lifting
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: Telekinesis over an area: carries loose things to storage, sweeps snow and filth. With release, the blast becomes a wave that throws foes back.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: growth
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: Ecological: plants in the area grow and ripen, your people and animals heal; anchored, the soil grows richer a cell at a time.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: amplification
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: More power, and more instability.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: reach
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: Carries the effect to a point you choose when the ritual begins, anywhere on the map: filling, purging, holding, drawing out, lifting, growth, release and the barrier dome all act there.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: breadth
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: Widens the reach of the ritual by four cells.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: anchor
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: Makes the effect last: the ritual repeats while the energy streams.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: safety
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: Locks the stream in and out and cuts the power. When the performer's composure gives, it throws them clear before the ritual breaks. A circle of nothing but safety runes is a Trap.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: closing
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: Keeps the energy inside: no leaks. Without it a part leaks out - and a ritual that never fills may become an endless vortex. In a spell it closes its circle: the element stays pure and does not meet its neighbours.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: focus
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: Draws the external stream into the ritual: the more energy on the map, the more it gives - and the less predictable it is. In a spell it draws the stream into its circle: stronger (+20%, more under a strong stream), harder to hold.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: barrier
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: A blast of the ritual spares your people and buildings. Anchored, with no verb: a dome that stops shots from outside while the energy holds it. A barrier pulls the map's stream by itself.

Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.label: thread
Avir.Ritualistics.RuneDef.description: Draws a thin grey thread from the circle to chosen things anywhere on the map, three per rune: filling reaches them, drawing out takes from them, a Trap feeds or milks along them, transmutation into current charges their grids. In a spell it turns a step round: not the caster goes to the target - the one at the target is drawn to the caster.
